description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'ProviderSearchFilterParams' that extends a base filter parameters class. The class is used to encapsulate filter criteria such as name, status, and id for searching providers within the OpenID authentication plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It also specifies allowed sort fields for querying provider data.

classes.name: ProviderSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used to hold filter parameters for searching provider records, including name, status, and id, with allowed sort fields defined as a constant.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the provider's name filter criterion.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the provider's name filter criterion.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the provider's status filter criterion.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the provider's status filter criterion.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the provider's id filter criterion.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the provider's id filter criterion.
